svg.title: CHRONA Batch 6 — Settings & Personalization Contact Sheet
svg.desc: Complete 4x3 visual overview of all 11 Settings screens on 412x915dp AMOLED canvases.
svg.text: CHRONA Batch 6 — Settings & Personalization Contact Sheet
11 Artboards · 412 × 915dp AMOLED Grid · Shared Reusable Settings Row, Toggle & Section Header Components

g.title: CHRONA — Settings Home
g.desc: Quiet, organized Settings home grouped into Appearance, Clock, Alarms, World Clock, and General.

g.title: CHRONA — Appearance & Theme
g.desc: System, Light, Dark, and AMOLED Black theme cards with miniature UI previews.

g.text: Keep #000000 canvas in Dark & AMOLED modes

g.title: CHRONA — Accent Color Picker
g.desc: Eight curated accent swatches with live component preview for button, navigation pill, switch, map marker, and alarm card.

g.title: CHRONA — Custom Accent Color
g.desc: HSL & HEX custom accent color editor with AMOLED contrast verification.

g.text: Desaturated tones prevent halation on true black
AMOLED screens while keeping timezone strips distinct.

g.title: CHRONA — City Image Settings
g.desc: City photograph toggle with visual demonstration showing that each city's pastel identity strip remains preserved.

g.text: Display skyline thumbnails on World Clock cards
Identity color strips always stay visible
Hiding photographs keeps each city's pastel strip & map link.
IMAGES DISABLED · REBALANCED WITH IDENTITY STRIP

g.title: CHRONA — Time Preferences
g.desc: 12-hour vs 24-hour time format, show seconds toggle, date format, and week start day.

g.text: Display live seconds on clocks & World Clock

g.title: CHRONA — Notification Preferences
g.desc: Alarm notifications, timer notifications, bedtime reminders, and background weather refresh toggles.

g.text: Update saved city weather every 3 hours

g.title: CHRONA — Alarm Preferences
g.desc: Default ringtone, vibration, snooze duration, gradual volume ramp, and exact-alarm status.

g.title: CHRONA — World Clock Settings
g.desc: Default reference city, weather display, map animations, card image visibility, and map appearance.

g.text: Show secondary temperature in city details

g.title: CHRONA — Screensaver Preferences
g.desc: Screensaver enable, clock style, brightness, display behavior, selected city, ambient animation, and appearance.

g.text: Start automatically while charging or docked
Gentle pixel shift for AMOLED burn-in care

g.title: CHRONA — About
g.desc: Minimal About screen with Chrona app icon, branding, version, description, privacy policy, licenses, and feedback.

g.text: A quiet, Pixel-inspired AMOLED world clock
Share ideas or report timezone issues
